related_questions.question: What happened to Western National life insurance company?

text_blocks.snippet: National Western Life Insurance Company, part of National Western Life Group, Inc., was acquired by Prosperity Life Group in July 2024. The acquisition was an all-cash transaction, with S. USA Life Insurance Company, Inc., an affiliate of Prosperity Life Group, acquiring National Western in a merger. As a result of the merger, National Western's stock was delisted from the Nasdaq.

list.title: Acquisition Agreement:
list.snippet: In October 2023, National Western Life Group announced an agreement to be acquired by Prosperity Life Group.

list.title: Merger Details:
list.snippet: The acquisition was an all-cash merger, with S. USA Life Insurance Company acquiring National Western.

list.title: Merger Completion:
list.snippet: The merger was completed in July 2024.

list.title: Consequences:
list.snippet: As part of the merger, National Western's stock was delisted from the Nasdaq, and the company became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Prosperity Life Group, according to Wikipedia.
